defects.detail: iOS app red-boxed on EVERY launch (Debug AND Release): "Cannot read property useState of null" at app/_layout.tsx:12 (useFonts in RootLayout). Root cause: apps/mobile had no metro.config.js, so in the pnpm monorepo Metro double-instantiated React (null hooks dispatcher). Fixed by adding the monorepo Metro config (realpath React redirect). After the fix the app launches and every screen above renders.
